notes: Verified entry list, grid and final classification. Location-based 3D is only enabled when an actual recorded positional snapshot is bundled.
Calendar race time is scheduled UTC; a replay origin is only established when a recorded session-start record is available. Final classification is distinct from live position updates.
Lap times, compounds, intervals and positional telemetry are shown only when separately available. Results are never converted into invented car trajectories.

Lap start/duration/sectors, position updates, stints, pits and race control are recorded OpenF1 data. Pit entry time is inferred as message timestamp minus recorded pit-lane duration, not an exact crossing time. Stationary service duration remains null when the provider did not supply it.
No coordinates or car telemetry are bundled for this timing-only entry. Replay cameras require a separate full recorded-location snapshot.

Lap start/duration/sectors, position updates, stints, pits and race control are recorded OpenF1 data. Pit entry time is inferred as message timestamp minus recorded pit-lane duration, not an exact crossing time. Stationary service duration remains null when the provider did not supply it.
No coordinates or car telemetry are bundled for this timing-only entry. Replay cameras require a separate full recorded-location snapshot.

Position displays retain the latest actual provider position update, including the pre-start grid update when a driver never changes position. This is a recorded last-known position, not a newly inferred overtake.
